title: Elaine Malloy's Algae

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: If you're back to wave some more of your brutish snaps under my nose, do it quickly. I don't have the energy to be polite today.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you're back to wave some more of your brutish snaps under my nose, do it quickly. I don't have the energy to be polite today.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Where have you been? I’m gasping. Well, hand it over.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where have you been? I’m gasping. Well, hand it over.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Finally. I hope it's still extra hot?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Finally. I hope it's still extra hot?

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: As lacking in social skills as you are in talent, I see. Move along, you're blocking my view.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As lacking in social skills as you are in talent, I see. Move along, you're blocking my view.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Good. Move along now, you're blocking my view.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good. Move along now, you're blocking my view.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Are you trying to be funny?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you trying to be funny?

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: I would never order anything so vile.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I would never order anything so vile.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Does it look like I'd drink something so vulgar?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Does it look like I'd drink something so vulgar?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Extra hot or not, it's what you're getting.
